name: rental
summary: Car-rental operations: fleet, customers, drivers and branches
description: Manage a vehicle-rental business: a fleet tracked per branch with daily/weekly/monthly rates and deposits, a customer register (CPR, driving licence), drivers, and a live operations dashboard (available / rented / under maintenance, per branch). Orders, quotations, invoices, receipts, replacements and maintenance build on this foundation.
